subject: Delivery time for Thursday
text:
Hello,

I hope you're doing well. I'm writing to arrange the delivery of the extra office chairs we mentioned last week. The supplier has given us a three-hour window on Thursday, but they need a contact person on site to receive them. Our usual loading entrance is reserved for maintenance until 2 pm, so the safest option is to have the shipment arrive after 3 pm. If that works on your side, could you confirm that someone will be available near the rear corridor and let me know which floor should be used? The packages are quite bulky, so I want to make sure we have enough clearance in the lift. I can call the courier once you confirm the best point of contact. No need to reply immediately, but a short note by Wednesday afternoon would be very helpful. Thanks for your help.

Also, if the corridor light remains faulty, I will arrange temporary lighting beforehand so the team does not have to move furniture in the dark. I appreciate your flexibility while the access schedule is unstable.

Best,
